THE PARLOUR / TAKE YOUR TIME

Living Perimeter

Move different crawling pieces around one connected hive to surround an opposing queen.

Restart this deal
Another deal

A THOUGHTFUL LITTLE MATCH

Find your next move.

Pin articulation pieces, climb to free a blocked route, choose which side of queen to close without disconnecting own mobility. Placing early secures future entry but consumes a movement turn.

Take a seat
How to play
Hex cells start empty. Each player has queen, two ants, two beetles and two grasshoppers. Placement must touch own pieces and no enemy after opening; queen must be placed by fourth own turn. Thereafter move or place. Queen slides one perimeter step, ant any sliding perimeter path, grasshopper jumps a contiguous occupied line, beetle climbs one neighbor stack. Removing a piece may never split hive. Sliding cannot pass a two-neighbor pinch. Covered piece cannot move.
Surround all six neighbors of enemy queen to win; own queen surrounded loses; both simultaneously surrounded draws. Repetition draws.

Placement and one-hive rule

Each side has queen1, ant2, beetle2, grasshopper2. First placement touches the hive; later placements touch at least one of your top pieces and no enemy top piece.
